title: Energy-Flow Cosmology: Empirical Validation of the EFC Screening Model Against the Radial Acceleration Relation
abstract: This paper empirically tests the Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC) screening model against the SPARC Radial Acceleration Relation (RAR), obtaining k = 0.415 ± 0.029, g† = (2.51 ± 0.60) × 10^-10 m/s^2, and intrinsic scatter ≈0.14 dex via an unbinned likelihood with bootstrap uncertainties. It extends the analysis to KiDS-1000 weak lensing showing a substantial likelihood improvement (Δ[-2 ln L] = −50.9) and demonstrates a cross-scale consistency through the phase-gain C = k/a_G = 4.4 ± 0.6 with a_G independently inferred from the H0 tension.
